testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle the direct panel list without changing a checkbox: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:242:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle the direct panel list without changing a checkbox ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with the Modify panel visible ✔ When the user clicks the direct panel selector arrow ✔ Then the panel list opens with Modify checked ✔ When the user clicks the direct panel selector arrow again ✔ Then the panel list closes ✔ And the Modify panel remains visible
